description: Resumable tracker for polishing notification-kit and releasing 2.1.0. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. Read 00-overview.md + findings.md for context.

userDecisions.npmRelease: Claude publishes directly (npm publish) at Phase 11, then reports.
userDecisions.peerDepFloors: Raise to latest stable (Capacitor >=8, firebase >=12.13.0, react >=19.2.6, react-onesignal >=3.5.3). Document loudly in changelog (KR-1).
userDecisions.featureScope: Harden + complete existing, backward-compatible only. No net-new large features. Native OneSignal SDK + async Web-Crypto storage explicitly OUT (made honest).

knownRisks: KR-1: peer major floor raise on a minor bump is non-standard semver -> loud changelog note
KR-2: TS6 / ESLint10 / Vite8 majors may break build/lint -> cluster + verify
KR-3: CP-M6 OneSignal v3 rewrite is riskiest -> base on installed @3.5.3 types
KR-4: adding CJS build changes pipeline -> verify import AND require resolve
KR-5: do NOT write new automated tests unless user asks (workspace rule); run existing as gate

runHistory.summary: Fresh start. Ran 3 parallel deep-audit agents + dependency sweep. Synthesized findings.md (8 critical, ~19 high, ~25 med, ~20 low). Captured 3 user decisions. Wrote overview + tracker + 11 phase specs.

Updated ALL deps to latest stable (incl. majors TS6, ESLint10, Vite8, jsdom29, lint-staged17, plugin-react6, dts5). Removed deprecated @testing-library/react-hooks. Raised peer floors (Capacitor8/firebase12.13/react19.2.6/onesignal3.5.3). Toolchain fixes: tsconfig baseUrl->relative paths + types:[node]; localStorage mock in test setup. Baseline 13 red tests -> 124/124 green. type-check+build+lint+test all clean.

Security: OneSignal sendNotification refuses client-side (REST-key leak), in-app icon XSS removed (safe applyIcon, zero innerHTML sinks), stripHtml doc, config-validator heuristic dropped + browser-safe. Core: emit() envelope fix + onPush firing, native listener cleanup, real per-platform capability matrix (isSupported works), getDelivered mapping, numeric-id validation, storage unicode-safe obfuscation + clear()/TTL fixes, Firebase top-level title/body + native FCM register + refreshToken safety, openSettings honest throw, logging in catches. Updated 5 tests to assert corrected behavior. 124/124 green.

React hooks: in-app polling replaced by manager subscription (RU-C1), useNotifications functional updater + single subscription (RU-C2), listenerId counter (RU-C3), schedule shape (RU-H2), configure functional + memoized returns + isPermissionGranted (RU-M6/L7/L8, PK-H4), logged swallowed errors (RU-M9). Utils: scheduling date math (RU-H3/H4/H5), cron DOW mapping (RU-H6), formatting guards + substr->slice (RU-M3/M4/M5/L2), dynamic-loader module-not-found vs runtime error (RU-L4). Updated 6 in-app tests. 124/124 green.

OneSignal v3 rewrite (CP-M6): external.d.ts stub + provider rewritten to v3 namespaced API; ZERO unsafe casts; provider+setup mocks updated to v3. CP-H5/M7/H7/H8 provider honesty. Logger (STD-1): leveled (default warn) + localStorage switch + opt-in devtools. ESLint no-console:'error' (STD-2/PK-H5) + ecmaVersion 2022; grep gate zero. 124/124 green.

Packaging: engines.node>=20, sideEffects:false, dual ESM+CJS + exports conditions (verified require+import), ship SW templates + setup.js deploy, single-sourced version, SW Firebase 12.13.0, setup.js red+URL, removed vite test block + .npmignore. Fixed external.d.ts dist leak + Node localStorage warning. 124/124 green.

Docs: fixed Readme + AI-INTEGRATION-GUIDE API mismatches; widened cancel proxy + completed recurring schedule mapping; CHANGELOG 2.1.0 + peer-dep note; versions->2.1.0; refreshed root + 12 nested CLAUDE/AGENTS; portfolio refreshed+renamed. 124/124 green.

RELEASE: bumped to 2.1.0, full gate green (124/124), committed (306f221) + pushed, then npm publish. Verified live: npm view notification-kit version=2.1.0, dist-tags.latest=2.1.0, dual ESM/CJS exports.

Post-release polish for 2.1.1: resolved all deferred minors (CP-M2 permission-routing doc, CP-L3 version parse, CP-L4 tablet detection, CP-L8 dead-code removal, RU-L9 day-rollover doc); wired the `in` schedule option (number|Duration -> future at) + fixed README scheduling examples; authored 15 Docusaurus website docs + logo (parallel sub-agent). 124/124 green. Published notification-kit@2.1.1 (verified npm latest=2.1.1). FEATURE COMPLETE.

resumeInstructions: 1) Read this tracker. 2) Read 00-overview.md + findings.md. 3) Find the first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress'. 4) Read that phase's spec file. 5) Invoke matching skills per RULE #0 for that phase. 6) Do the work; run the phase gate. 7) Mark sub-tasks 'complete', append a runHistory row, bump lastUpdated. 8) ONE commit per session including this tracker. 9) Phase 11.4 (npm publish) is the only irreversible step — user pre-authorized direct publish; still verify gates first.
